title: National Lampoon's Animal House (VHS, 1998, Widescreen) John Belushi - Sealed
descriptionText: The product is a sealed VHS tape of National Lampoon's Animal House (1978 film) in widescreen format, featuring the iconic comedy performance by John Belushi. Produced by Universal Studios in the United States, this film is presented in English language with NTSC signal standard, suitable for R-rated audiences. This collectible item is a must-have for fans of classic comedy and John Belushi enthusiasts looking to enjoy the hilarious antics of the beloved cast in the comfort of their own home.
